definition: Stable identity for the original source video, shared by all cells.
Exact source basename including extension; retain Camera and ACT tokens.
Canonical original-video location; review MP4 is a different artifact.
Content hash, not a filename hash.
Acquisition date/time from authoritative metadata; retain precision and source.
Camera serial/name from acquisition record or verified filename mapping.
Actual source frame rate; use frame timestamps if variable-frame-rate.
Total decoded source frames, independently checked.
Original image dimensions; separate from review crop dimensions.
Measured scale with calibration artifact; null if unavailable.
Stable physical experimental trial/cell identifier across reruns.
Links to recordings.
Exact TOML cell label, e.g. A2; source stem retained separately.
Original configuration name and immutable path.
Hash of original configuration; submitted copies separately recorded.
DYADIC_FIGHT for this handoff; BA and SIX_BEETLE remain separate scopes.
Verified design metadata; null until mapped, not inferred.
Expected identities, 2 for dyads.
Release/experimental time origin, source and reviewer; may differ from tracking start.
Original-coordinate arena and ordered fungus polygons.
Boundary drawing protocol and attributed verification.
TOML start before any approved revision.
Unique IDtracker attempt; never overwrite a prior attempt.
Physical trial processed.
Exact session and selected trajectory file.
Hashes of actual inputs used downstream.
Raw, validated or gap-processed input; use exact recorded category.
Version from environment/log for this attempt, not current installed version.
From execution records; preserve unknown and timestamp provenance.
Log/manifest/manual attribution/unknown, with evidence URI.
Immutable SIF/image digest and dependency capture.
RUNNING, COMPLETE, FAILED, COMPLETE_WITH_WARNING or UNKNOWN with log evidence.
Execution evidence; scheduler success alone does not establish valid tracking.
Unique post-processing attempt; joins every derived table.
Exact upstream attempt.
Current verified local values 0.8.2-group, 1.6.0, 0.8.1; record actual deployed versions per run.
Git revision plus hash of actual dirty/frozen source bundle; revision alone is insufficient.
Display version and exact code hash; display changes do not change science version.
Separate QC, table contract and scientific-definition versions.
Actual processor execution times; packaging and review times are separate.
All resolved settings including inactive legacy arguments explicitly marked.
Current defaults 60, 30, 30; retain resolved values.
Current defaults 200 and 100; retain inequality convention.
Current latency threshold 30 px.
Separate successful computation from UNREVIEWED/NEEDS_REVIEW/ACCEPTED_FOR_METRIC.
Exact output provenance manifest; timestamps may need new instrumentation.
Zero-based run-local tracking index, not biological identity.
Validated experimental individual ID; no automatic cross-run match.
Human mapping and CONFIRMED/UNCERTAIN/UNKNOWN.
Attribution and source frames/record.
Explicit named interval, e.g. full or post_both_move_3600_intervals.
Original global indices; never renumber scientific coordinates.
N and N-1; requested and actual values must match or status fails.
N/fps and (N-1)/fps, respectively.
Full, individual crossing or latest pair crossing; explicit unavailable/truncated status.
Human-approved excluded intervals with attribution; retain as unknown.
Layer RAW_INPUT or PSC_ESTIMATED; do not pool layers as replicates.
Existing animals.csv latency; seconds=frames/fps. Exact-start continuous-chain rule.
First reachable threshold crossing, not necessarily first physical movement.
OBSERVED, NOT_REACHED_FULL_COVERAGE, MISSING_BASELINE, CHAIN_BROKEN, START_ALREADY_MOVING or UNRESOLVED; adapter must distinguish legacy ambiguous status.
Located versus unknown observations within this window.
Disjoint location evidence classes; do not count inferred as observed.
Valid coordinate frames/window_n_frames, separately by layer.
Partition N-1 candidate steps; no incoming step from before window.
Sum Euclidean adjacent steps passing this layer's cutoff; null if none evaluable.
Accepted_steps/fps.
Distance/accepted_step_time_s; null for zero denominator.
Distance/window_duration_s, explicitly coverage-dependent, not interchangeable with conditional speed.
Diagnostic maximum and count of consecutive finite raw displacements >100 px, independent of movement cutoff.
Contiguous unknown runs; record censoring at window edges.
Attributed metric-specific eligibility; null before review, not inferred from no warnings.
Long-format wall, any_fungus, fungus_1..N, open_arena, fungus edge/interior etc.
Centroid membership from regions.csv coordinate_frames.
Region frames/fps; unknown frames excluded from numerator.
Region frames/valid_coordinate_frames for this layer/window.
Region frames/window_n_frames; accompanying coverage required.
Accepted steps whose midpoint is in region.
Midpoint-allocated distance from regions.csv; not perimeter arc length.
Region distance/(region_accepted_steps/fps).
Optional consecutive known outside-to-inside transitions; unknown boundaries censored.
Optional fully observed visit durations; censored visits retained separately.
One unordered pair; a<b. A dyad contributes one pair, not two independent observations.
Both raw-input IDs located; existing pairs.csv jointly_visible_frames.
Both assigned centroids <=60 px; frames/fps.
Observed proximity frames/jointly located frames; null if denominator zero.
Existing proximity_bouts: contiguous positive segments, including censored ones.
Segments with known outside state at both boundaries; unknown breaks cannot establish separate complete interactions.
Pair-specific missing-ID PSC evidence; never called touching time.
Neither measurable two-ID distance nor supported PSC; state mapping explicitly versioned.
Optional union of observed proximity and supported PSC, no double counting; separate from primary observed proximity.
First observed positive relative to window start; mark starts-already-near and unknown-before-onset.
Fully bounded bouts only in primary summary; censored durations listed separately.
Median center distance over jointly located frames, irrespective of proximity.
UNREVIEWED/SUSPECTED/CONFIRMED/RESOLVED with attributed evidence.
Unique event identity within processing run, pair and window.
Exact run/pair context.
OBSERVED_PROXIMITY or INFERRED_PSC; human TOUCH/MOUNT/ATTACK separately sourced, never auto-substituted.
Event bounds in original video.
End-start+1 and count/fps.
Window edge, missing evidence, exclusion or known transition.
Event definition version and optional linked human review.
Per-animal evidence; pair_frames replaces animal_id with sorted pair.
Preserve original and inferred coordinates side by side.
Exact processor evidence states, including missing/ambiguous; no imputation to zero.
Membership and adjacent-step evidence; first step is not applicable.
Observed distance plus OBSERVED_NEAR/OBSERVED_APART/INFERRED_PSC/UNKNOWN; validate mutually exclusive mapping.
Attributed decision; preserve original review export hash.
Exactly which version, metric and frames were inspected; unseen is not approved.
Append-only decisions and revisions; never overwrite original annotations.
Video, TOML, trajectory, CSV, PDF, HTML, review JSON, log and code bundle inventory.
Creation/export time, separate from acquisition and computation dates.
Exactly one selected result per trial/metric/versioned analysis release; do not silently choose newest rerun.
